note: Held-out evaluation only. These queries and expectations must never be copied into training data. Every required source id is a record that exists in this repository's indexes; nothing here states a legal rule that is not in a cited record.

fields.requiredIslamicSources: record keys from rag/indexes/islamic_index.json that must appear among the answer's Islamic sources
fields.requiredLegalSources: record keys from rag/indexes/rag_index.json that must appear among the answer's legal sources
fields.mustMention: case-insensitive substrings the answer text must contain
fields.mustNotMatch: regular expressions the answer text must not match
fields.variant: short | detailed — short expects a compact answer (maxAnswerChars), detailed allows the full sourced answer
